scope: Every nonpublic instance property DECLARED ON these two exact owner-wrapper types plus the two named pool fault mutation hooks. Exact compiled metadata equality, no suffix filtering.
unreviewedScope: Other private/runtime/demo/API/lease/composite members, full useful-work published/managed matrix, final package/native platforms remain essential. ConcurrentArenaLease<T>.KernelForComposite belongs to another type.

fields.name: CurrentLifecycle
fields.definition: Actual owner Active/Unleased/Returned/Disposed gate; observing it grants no lease authority.

fields.resetPolicy: Actual owner lifecycle observation, including Unleased/Returned/Disposed; no read resets or reopens the gate.
fields.overflow: Finite validated lifecycle enum; not an incrementing gauge.
fields.allocation: No managed/native allocation; existing gate and scalar/value-tuple copy only.

faultMutationMethods.name: SetScopeEpochForTest
faultMutationMethods.definition: Replace actual active generation scope plus active scoped/pending identities under the gate for exhaustion proof; absent active generation refuses.

faultMutationMethods.name: SetGenerationCounterForTest
faultMutationMethods.definition: Replace real lifetime generation history under the gate for checked-transition exhaustion; does not activate a generation or grant payload authority.
